flags.why: Calling a woman a shrew or a bullying wife is derogatory, even when intended humorously.

The expression describes passable female looks, rather than general satisfactory quality, as documented in this [dictionary](https://medialib.qlgd.edu.vn/Uploads/THU_VIEN/shn/1/1124/UserFiles/Tu-Dien-Tieng-Viet-Hoang-Long-thuviensach.vn-b6c5cba7-6d08-4fa4-aae4-6b53ec52276c.pdf).
flags.fix: passably pretty; reasonably good-looking (of a woman)

flags.why: The food example incorrectly applies an expression used to describe a woman's appearance ([dictionary](https://medialib.qlgd.edu.vn/Uploads/THU_VIEN/shn/1/1124/UserFiles/Tu-Dien-Tieng-Viet-Hoang-Long-thuviensach.vn-b6c5cba7-6d08-4fa4-aae4-6b53ec52276c.pdf)).
flags.fix: Cô ấy trông cũng sạch nước cản. = She is reasonably good-looking.
